comment: Recognition layer 2: community signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon projected into world space via road.project(). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. Entries marked needs_owner_review require owner's lived knowledge to confirm — coordinate placement is map-derived, not lived. All IDs are stable from creation (standing rule: future sign/ad system depends on them).

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow spit between Kingston Harbour and the open Caribbean — coconut trees both sides, Gun Boat Beach on the left

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout community where the Palisadoes strip meets the mainland — gateway into Kingston proper

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston community — Rockfort Mineral Bath is the local landmark

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community above Mountain View Avenue in east Kingston

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: The capital — National Stadium, National Heroes Park, the full city bustle

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Uptown Kingston commercial hub — the 1813 clock tower marks the centre

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: The former colonial capital — Spanish Court, Rodney Memorial, White Marl Taino Museum

communities.name: Caymanas
communities.note: St Catherine community near Caymanas Bay and the Rio Cobre flood plains

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Rio Cobre gorge — dramatic limestone cliffs and the famous Flat Bridge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St Catherine market town — forever linked to the Linstead Market folk song

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community on the climb from Linstead toward Ewarton and Moneague

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St Catherine community with the Alcan Jamaica alumina plant — on the hill climb toward Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads at the top of the hill — cool air, panoramic views, goat country

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: The legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: St Ann hillside community on the descent toward the north coast

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: St Ann community on the descent toward Ocho Rios

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: A 3-km canopy road through a lush ravine — bamboo arching overhead, cool shade on the way into Ochi

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: North coast resort town — journey's end, Dunn's River Falls just ahead
